changes: early stop of the update by target_kl 0.03: MaskablePPO stops an update when the KL of one minibatch is above 1.5 x 0.03 = 0.045. S1's logged approx_kl (the mean over the minibatches of the last pass that ran: sb3_contrib resets the list at the start of each pass, so for S0-S6 it is the 10th pass, the largest KL of the update) was 0.075-0.123 by fifth of training, so the stop binds in every phase of training and should keep the KL of an update near the common 0.01-0.02. A target_kl of 0.02 (stop at 0.03) would likely end most updates in the first or second pass and 0.05 (stop at 0.075) would barely bind early in training
